The water point can distribute up to 6,000 gallons across three windows tomorrow — 0700-0900, 0900-1100, and 1300-1500. The standard plan requests 1,800 gallons for the clinic, 1,600 gallons for engineer washdown, and 1,200 gallons for personnel services. Are there any updates or changes to those requirements from either of you before I finalize the schedule?
